en: macOS's own prompts on the other Mac (passwords, Touch ID, permissions) now appear over the window you are using, so you can answer them from here.
While such a prompt is open, typing stays with it and never goes to the app instead.
zh-Hans: 对方 Mac 上 macOS 自己的提示（密码、触控 ID、权限请求）现在会显示在你正在用的窗口上，可以直接在这边回应。
提示打开时，键盘输入只会进入提示框，不会落到 App 里。
